description: This is the main application component 'App.js' for a React frontend. It sets up routing with react-router-dom, including navigation links, route definitions for pages like Home, Services, Parts, Service Centers, Auth, and Profile. It manages user authentication state via localStorage and provides a logout button.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the application shell with navigation and routing logic.
methods.returns: JSX element representing the application's layout.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout by clearing the access token from localStorage and updating authentication state.
